title: 地区销售额
query: 只查询 askdata_mock：统计2026年8月实付金额大于0的订单，按订单地区汇总实付金额。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: SELECT orders_current.region AS "地区", SUM(orders_current.paid_amount) AS "实付金额合计" FROM orders_current WHERE orders_current.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' AND orders_current.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY orders_current.region ORDER BY "实付金额合计" DESC
